inherited_release_gate.note: All sealed dev6 HORNET prism-wall, full-armor, grounded-CRAB, PROGRESSIVE barrier-orientation, beginner-GUI and inherited native-format/source-only gates remain inherited. Dev7 resolves the separate HORNET state-6 propagation attack as a deterministic seed+wave family.

fresh_package.note: Candidate was extracted fresh, verified against RELEASE_MANIFEST with no unlisted files, independently source-audited before executing package code, and then passed 89/89 selftests plus CLI/GUI version and propagation-control checks. Final package is rebuilt deterministically after recording this evidence.

limitations: HORNET state-6 propagation catalogs are activation-instant snapshots; transient beam/effect objects and the subsequent 0-to-45-degree prism turn are not frozen into static geometry.
HORNET propagation inherits one of 13 runtime prism-wall seeds; there is deliberately no single canonical unqualified propagation preset.
HORNET prism-wall catalog remains a 13-variant runtime-random family; there is deliberately no single canonical unqualified prism-wall preset.
A1 is hidden during the recovered state-6 propagation attack; visible activation snapshots contain reached C0 prisms only.
HORNET full-armor remains the deterministic 125-BF C1 sample-0 lattice state.
CRAB default remains the executable/ANM-backed landed combat-loop sample 1; crab_first_visible preserves the airborne sample-167 intro.
PROGRESSIVE UFO remains the first recovered five-part runtime formation; its barrier tilt is native authored GMX orientation.
Native SIIG coordinate scale is preserved; no speculative meter conversion or hidden display scaling is applied.
True blended/multi-joint deformation is not encoded because no confirmed native per-vertex skin representation exists.
Assembly export produces a combined glTF viewing/editing scene; it does not claim the retail game stores or accepts one merged native GMX.
Runtime acceptance of arbitrary fully original synthesized scenes remains a separate emulator/hardware gate.
Platform shader microcode compilation and remaining opaque GMX semantics remain unresolved.
Compressed/mipmapped native texture variants are not synthesized.
PS3 donor-free TEX wrapper synthesis remains structurally validated rather than hardware/emulator-proven.
PS3 NPDRM/SDAT re-encryption is not implemented.
